question: Should OpenClaw adopt this new operator-facing readiness configuration and plugin-SDK criterion API as part of the RFC 0018 readiness stack before the prerequisite framework has landed?
rationale: This is a large, cross-cutting feature that defines configuration, Gateway, CLI, protocol, and plugin contracts; source-level correctness alone cannot decide whether those permanent public surfaces should exist.

options.title: Sponsor the staged readiness API
options.body: Accept the RFC direction, land the prerequisite framework first, and require this PR to rebase with explicit upgrade and live-runtime proof.

options.title: Narrow to prerequisite-only work
options.body: Ask the contributor to remove owner criteria and plugin SDK expansion until the base readiness contract is merged and stable.

options.title: Decline the core surface
options.body: Keep readiness extensions out of core unless a maintainer defines a smaller supported contract or plugin seam.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the staged readiness API
recommendation.body: Accept the RFC direction, land the prerequisite framework first, and require this PR to rebase with explicit upgrade and live-runtime proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the only concrete routing candidate in the supplied readiness-stack history, though final product direction requires a repository maintainer.
